questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{若均值}\mu_{1},\mu_{2}\text{未知，则}\\&(1)\text{检验假设为}H_{0}:\sigma_{1}^{2}=\sigma_{2}^{2},\;H_{1}:\sigma_{1}^{2}\neq\sigma_{2}^{2}.\\&(2)\text{若}H_{0}\text{为真，则有}F=\frac{\displaystyle\frac{1}{n_{1}-1}\sum_{i=1}^{n_{1}}(X_{i}-\overline{X})^{2}}{\displaystyle\frac{1}{n_{2}-1}\sum_{i=1}^{n_{2}}(Y_{i}-\overline{Y})}=\frac{S_{1}^{2}}{S_{2}^{2}}\sim F(n_{1}-1,n_{2}-1),\\&\text{此时拒绝域为}\left(0,F_{1-\omega_{2}}(n_{1}-1,n_{2}-1)\right)\cup\left(F_{\omega_{2}}(n_{1}-1,n_{2}-1),+\infty\right).\\&\text{另外，右侧检验：}H_{0}:\sigma_{1}^{2}=\sigma_{2}^{2},\;H_{1}:\sigma_{1}^{2}>\sigma_{2}^{2}.\;\text{此时拒绝域为}\left(F_{\omega}(n_{1}-1,n_{2}-1),+\infty\right).\\&\text{左侧检验：}H_{0}:\sigma_{1}^{2}=\sigma_{2}^{2},\;H_{1}:\sigma_{1}^{2}<\sigma_{2}^{2}.\;\text{此时拒绝域为}\left(0,F_{1-\omega}(n_{1}-1,n_{2}-1)\right).\end{aligned}
